def _render_to_grayscale(self) -> np.ndarray:
    observer_vehicle = self.observer_vehicle
    center_x, center_y = observer_vehicle.position  # Assuming position returns (x, y)
    self.viewer.set_center(center_x, center_y)  # Center the viewer on the observer vehicle
    self.viewer.display()
    raw_rgb = self.viewer.get_image()  # H x W x C
    raw_rgb = np.moveaxis(raw_rgb, 0, 1)
    return np.dot(raw_rgb[..., :3], self.weights).clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
